items.statement: The autonomous investigation validates retained stationary points and connects the selected pathway to the known product.
items.expected: Each retained minimum has zero imaginary frequencies; each claimed TS has exactly one plus endpoint/connectivity evidence, with object IDs retained.

items.statement: The report independently generates, deduplicates and discriminates plausible mechanism candidates, and gives a bounded stopping/limitation record.
items.expected: Candidate families, provenance, rejection reasons, coverage and stopping condition are explicit rather than a single unsupported mechanism assertion.

items.statement: The best-supported productive event has a quantitative activation free-energy result.
items.expected: The reported productive barrier is approximately 25.9 kcal/mol within the declared convention.

items.statement: The known acetate product has a quantitative relative free-energy result.
items.expected: The product relative free energy is approximately -20.2 kcal/mol within the declared convention.
